topics.name: Content Design
topics.description: Content design involves strategically planning, writing, and structuring text and narrative to guide users through digital experiences. It focuses on delivering the right information at the right time in a clear, concise, and accessible manner.
conventions: Prioritize user needs over organizational jargon.
Ensure consistency in voice and tone across all touchpoints.
Use progressive disclosure to prevent overwhelming the user with information.
Test content with real users to ensure comprehension and clarity.
